 महाराष्ट्र टाइम्स.कॉम India vs New Zealand 2nd T20I Live Streaming: Know when and where to watch India vs New Zealand live today in India, match time, TV channel and free viewing options.
 India vs New Zealand 2nd T20I Live Streaming: Cricket fans in India can catch the action as India take on New Zealand in the second T20I of the five-match series on Saturday, October 24. The match will be played at Hagley Oval in Christchurch, with the first ball scheduled for 12:30 PM IST. India enter the contest with a 1-0 lead after winning the series opener by four wickets in a high-scoring thriller. The visitors will aim to extend their advantage, while New Zealand will be desperate to level the series on home soil.
 For viewers planning to watch the match on television or a mobile phone, the key question is where the live telecast and online streaming will be available. Here's everything you need to know, including the options for watching the match free in India.
 IND vs NZ 2nd T20I live streaming: Where to watch in India
The second T20I between India and New Zealand will be broadcast on the Sony Sports Network in India. Fans who prefer watching the match online can use the SonyLIV app or website.
Live TV telecast: Sony Sports Network
 Live Events
 You Might Also Like: IND vs NZ 2nd T20I Playing 11 Prediction: Will Vaibhav Sooryavanshi play today?
 Live online streaming: SonyLIV app and website
 Free TV option: DD Sports on DD Free Dish
 Can you watch IND vs NZ 2nd T20I live for free?
Fans looking for a free viewing option can check DD Sports on DD Free Dish, which has been listed as a free television option for this match. Availability and coverage should be checked against the latest broadcast schedule.
For online viewers, SonyLIV is the official streaming platform reported for the series in India. However, free live streaming on SonyLIV has not been confirmed. Viewers should check the app for the match listing and any subscription requirements before the game starts.
 IND vs NZ 2nd T20I: Match date, time and venue
 Match detail Information 
 Match India vs New Zealand, 2nd T20I 
 Date Saturday, October 24, 2026 
 Venue Hagley Oval, Christchurch 
 Toss time 12:00 PM IST 
 Match start 12:30 PM IST 
 TV channel Sony Sports Network 
 Online streaming SonyLIV 
 Series score India lead 1-0 
 What happened in the first IND vs NZ T20I?
India began the series with a four-wicket victory after chasing down New Zealand's total of 225. The contest produced plenty of runs and kept the result in doubt until the closing overs.
India's batting unit will look to carry that momentum into the second match. New Zealand, meanwhile, need their bowlers to find a way to contain the visitors after conceding a big total in the opener.
Team selection is another talking point. Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of the second T20I with a right adductor strain, putting the spotlight on the possible inclusion of teenage batter Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.
